decisions.reason: Because the firm is growing and has enough slack to support experiments, it will likely keep this adjacent ecosystem-building program for another year, although its fit with the core machinery business is weaker than the others.
As a flagship product linked to the firm's strategic direction and in-house R&D strengths, this novel binder is likely to be retained while management learns from the market.
This flagship decontamination plant is very close to the established offer, so in a growing firm and industry it is likely to stay on the market despite normal launch uncertainty.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant fits the firm's core modular recycling business closely, so management is more likely to continue commercialization than to reallocate its resources.
